description: Zambia base case grid extensions is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by Shaky Sherpa (World Bank Group). Least-cost scenario - population connected to the grid extension. Coverage: Zambia. It has 2 files in SHP ZIP, GeoJSON. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
